title: MSHEM-06.01 General EHSS Rules
body: When a near-miss gets waved off because "nothing happened," that's the exact gap MSHEM-06.01 exists to close — and it's how the same unsafe act repeats until it isn't a near-miss anymore. ADW runs under this standard whether or not the specific rule matches local habit.
keyPoints: Enforce every violation, every time — not just the ones that cause a loss. Outcome doesn't excuse the breach (§5.1.11).
Where site SOP and Saudi regulation disagree, the stricter one wins. Never assume the local way is the floor.
The nine Life Saving Rules must be visible, discussed at toolbox talks, and actually verified in use — not just posted on a board.
Every corrective action needs a named owner and a target date. Pushing that date isn't a supervisor call — first slip needs Director sign-off, second needs SVP.
"Ask if unsure" is a real rule, not a throwaway line — it's the everyday partner to the right to stop work.
apply: If you catch a bypassed brake check, a skipped LOTO step, or a shortcut at the loading face and it didn't lead to anything — write it up and enforce it anyway, because that's the exact scenario this standard was built for.
